Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Meii Drenin: 29-year-old man, 163 cm (short), ordinary lean-to-average construction without visible definition, skin value band-2-light. Face: round full face; small bright eyes and fine straight brows; long straight nose, narrow upper lip; one brow notch. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: dark-brown, shaved-close-cropped, deliberate accent: sculpted edge pattern. Wardrobe: apron-workwear-layers, specifically a work shirt, asymmetrical apron layers, reinforced trousers, and sturdy shoes; rolled sleeves and one architectural lapel; bounded palette indigo-sand. Visible personal details: a wrapped keepsake cord; a tiny nose stud; a repaired cuff with bright thread. Make unusual but bounded color blocking the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: severe grooming softened by one unruly feature. Color treatment: uses high-contrast lining visible only in motion. Pose cue: weight settles into one heel, shoulders square, hands relaxed and completely visible. Include a tiny cloth-wrapped notebook only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.
